# Valley Pawn - Enterprise Changelog

Newest first. Material changes to the business operating system. Read this BEFORE any build, fix or diagnosis.

## 2026-11-17 (weekly email — closed test loop LIVE; report fix live)

- Joshua: "you give feedback but never follow or execute your recommendations." NEW `bin/email_test_loop.py` + `.sh`: `apply` (Mon 13:15 after the deal picker, retries Tue/Wed 09:20) puts promoted winners on Thursday's queued weekly, then splits lists 7+13 into two random halves (new auto lists "Weekly test loop - half A/B"), control -> A, cloned variant "<name> [B]" -> B, same send time, seeds on both. The variant is created only after the control is verified on half A; any failure deletes the variant and restores [7,10,13]. `grade` (Fri 03:50, after analytics) scores store actions per 1,000 (call+text+directions buckets), WIN/LOSE at z>=1.28 after >=2 sends and >=20 actions, NO DIFFERENCE at 6 sends; winners are promoted onto every weekly. Backlog `Email Refinement/test_loop/backlog.json` (T1 top call/text strip, T2 text-a-photo quote, T3 no-appointment preview line, T4 directions strip).
